title: DNA extraction from gram negative bacteria
author: Louise Judd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p5mdq46

steps.title: Grow bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate a single colony into 2 mL appropriate growth medium, incubate overnight at 37 °C with shaking, transfer 1.5 mL of the overnight culture to a micro‑fuge tube, pellet the bacteria by centrifugation, and remove the supernatant. The bacterial pellet may be stored at –80 °C for later gDNA extraction.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve lyophilized RNase A (American Bioanalytical #AB14043) in 50 % glycerol with 10 mM Tris, pH 8.0 to a final concentration of 100 mg mL⁻¹ (store at –20 °C). Dissolve lyophilized Genfind Proteinase K in Genfind Proteinase K buffer to a final concentration of 96 mg mL⁻¹ (store at –20 °C).

steps.title: Lyse cells with master mix
steps.instruction: For each bacterial isolate, prepare a lysis master mix containing 400 µL Genfind lysis buffer, 9 µL Genfind Proteinase K (from the stock above), and 1 µL RNase A (from the stock above). Add 400 µL of this master mix to each bacterial pellet, tip‑mix gently 10 times to resuspend, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min. Proceed to DNA extraction.

steps.title: Bind DNA to magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Invert the Genfind binding buffer 20 times to fully resuspend the magnetic particles. Add 300 µL binding buffer to each lysed sample, tip‑mix gently 10 times avoiding bubbles, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, place the tube on a magnetic rack for 5 min (or until the solution clears), and with the tube on the magnet remove the supernatant without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Wash beads with Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL Genfind Wash Buffer 1 to each sample, tip‑mix 10 times (beads may clump), place on the magnetic rack for 5 min (or until clear), and remove the supernatant. Repeat this wash once more for a total of two Wash Buffer 1 washes.

steps.title: Wash beads with Buffer 2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Genfind Wash Buffer 2 to each sample, tip‑mix 10 times (beads may clump), place on the magnetic rack for 5 min (or until clear), and remove the supernatant. Repeat this wash once more for a total of two Wash Buffer 2 washes.

steps.title: Elute DNA from beads
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tubes to collect liquid at the bottom, place on the magnetic rack for 5 min (or until clear), and remove all residual Wash Buffer 2 without allowing the beads to dry. Add 50–200 µL (typically 100 µL) 10 mM Tris, pH 8.0, to each tube, remove from the magnet, tip‑mix 10 times, incubate at 37 °C for 5 min, tip‑mix again, place on the magnetic rack for 5 min (or until clear), and transfer the supernatant containing DNA to a clean micro‑fuge tube.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Store the eluted DNA at 4 °C; avoid storage at –20 °C because ice crystal formation can shear DNA. DNA can be kept at 4 °C for several weeks if needed for downstream library preparation.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Visualise the DNA on a Fragment Analyzer (gDNA 1–60 kb gel) to estimate fragment size. Quantify the DNA using a fluorometer (e.g., Qubit). Additionally, analyse 1 µL on a UV spectrophotometer (e.g., Nanodrop) for purity ratios.
